Link two calibrations onto a common scale

Source: R/linking.R
irt_link.Rd

Finds the linear transformation \(\theta^* = A\theta + B\) that places the from calibration on the scale of the to calibration using common (anchor) items, by the mean-mean, mean-sigma, Haebara or Stocking-Lord method.

Usage

irt_link(
  from,
  to,
  anchors = NULL,
  method = c("stocking-lord", "haebara", "mean-sigma", "mean-mean"),
  fix_slope = NULL
)

Arguments

from, to

irtfit (unidimensional) or irt_bank objects. from is transformed onto the scale of to.

anchors

Names of the common items. Defaults to all items whose names appear in both.

method

"stocking-lord" (default), "haebara", "mean-sigma" or "mean-mean".

fix_slope

Fix \(A = 1\)? Defaults to TRUE when every anchor is a Rasch-family item in both calibrations.

Value

An object of class irt_link with the constants A and B, the transformed bank (bank), the method and the anchors.

Examples

set.seed(1)
x <- sim_irt(800, 15, "2pl")
fx <- irt_fit(x[1:400, ], "2pl", se = "none")
fy <- irt_fit(x[401:800, ], "2pl", se = "none")
irt_link(fx, fy)
#> <irt_link> stocking-lord linking on 15 anchor item(s)
#>   theta(to) = 0.8354 * theta(from) + 0.0957
